ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation VAR++ LAUNCHER OBFUSCATION - System
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via VAR++ LAUNCHER Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045 AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*\\&\\&set.*") AND ImagePath = RGX(".*cmd.*") AND ImagePath = RGX(".*\\/c.*") AND ImagePath = RGX(".*\\-f.*")) AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*\\{0\\}.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\{1\\}.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\{2\\}.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\{3\\}.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\{4\\}.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\{5\\}.*")))
